_note: Copy this file to your project root as ds-config.json and fill in your values.

figma._modes_note: Define all your DS modes here. cssSelector values: 'root', 'dark-media', 'high-contrast-media', 'class:<name>', 'data:<attr>=<val>'
figma._legacy_note: OR use the legacy two-mode shorthand (ignored when 'modes' is present):

_rendered_note: Gate: Renders correctly in a browser. Needs Chrome (or CHROME_PATH) and a built UI in paths.plugins. auto:true generates height checks per component from the snapshot (no hand-typed values); colorScheme sets the default light/dark. Hand-written RENDERED_ASSERTIONS in structure-contract.mjs still work and override.
_visual_note: Directory for stored reference screenshots. Commit this dir to track visual history.
_webhook_note: Config for webhook-server.mjs. Run setup-webhook.mjs to register with Figma.
_componentProps_note: Gate: Component props match Figma. Reads code props from Vue/React and compares to Figma property names. Usually needs no config (components are auto-resolved by base selector or name).
_componentFiles_note: Optional explicit map when auto-resolution can't find the file: Figma component name -> source file path.
_componentPropAliases_note: Document intentional renames so they count as matches: Figma property name -> code prop name, per component.
_componentSrcDirs_note: Optional dirs to scan for .vue/.tsx/.jsx component files (default: src, components, app, lib, packages).
